question: How should dual-brain detect what AI providers a user has available?
claude_position: Only detect binary availability — Claude Code running (yes/no), OPENAI_API_KEY exists (yes/no), Codex CLI in PATH (yes/no). Never infer subscription tier.
gpt_position: Agree. Stop modeling unknowable state. Treat plan, limits, and preferences as user-provided configuration, not inferred.
synthesis: Detect ONLY verifiable availability. No subscription tier detection, no plan inference, no quota estimation. If we can't call an API to verify it, we don't claim to know it.
